critique.evidence: Across 1440px, 768px, and 390px viewports, the economics section has no detected viewport overflow or uncontained overflow, and no touch-target violations. Automated WCAG scans report no confirmed violations, but color contrast remains seriously incomplete for 32 economics nodes at every viewport because gradient backgrounds prevented calculation; affected content includes the title, explanatory copy, ledger labels, and values. No measured keyboard-navigation, focus-order, control-activation, or reduced-motion evidence was provided, so those requirements cannot be treated as passing.
critique.fix: Measure foreground/background contrast for every flagged node against the rendered gradient and adjust colors or use solid backing layers to meet WCAG AA. Add Playwright evidence for complete keyboard traversal, visible focus, logical focus order, and activation of the arena link without a pointer. Test prefers-reduced-motion and verify that nonessential transitions or animations are disabled. Re-run these checks at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
